notes.title: "Silent Legend" Epic Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
"Silent Legend" unveils an epic update! This version focuses on three core elements: hardcore fairness, exclusive exploration, and ultra-fast attack speed, creating a legendary world for all players to enjoy! Whether you're an office worker, a casual gamer, or a budget-conscious warrior, you can experience the thrill of common mobs dropping ultimate gear and casual players dominating whales!

Highlighted Features

1. Exclusive Identification System

All equipment randomly rolls 11 legendary affixes: Strength | Refinement | Demon Slaying | Bloodlust | Fortune | Ironclad | Fury | Severance | Savagery | Finesse | Swiftness!

Bloodlust affix is a must-have! Equip 3-7 for maximum lifesteal and effortless tanking!

Total affix count unlocks hidden divine powers, stacking skill buffs for explosive stat growth!

2. Instant Power Surge

Follow main quests to blaze through continental lore and claim free rewards from the top menu!

7-Day Power-Up Quests grant Spirit Essence and Feather Coins for a head start!

Slicing System: Blistering attack speed + fixed damage cuts through mobs like butter!

Aura System: Mid-to-late game爆发 (breakout) with boosted damage, drop rates, and elemental mastery!

3. Hardcore Fairness Mechanics

Minimal gap between whales and f2p players! All gear is farmable—even common mobs drop ultimate loot!

Casual player bonus: Fate Divination in the Second Continent offers a chance at free top-tier membership!

4. New Maps & Bosses
Second Continent - Bloody Caverns

Unlock hidden maps essential for achievement titles!

Daily bounty quests reward massive currency—farm and earn simultaneously!

Third Continent - Dragonflame Realm

Core exclusive "Dragon's Shockwave" (upgraded Tear Axe): Rare but sells for a fortune—first casual to loot it strikes gold!

Insect Nest drops Shadowrend Claw, a percentage-based slicing bracelet that shreds even white bosses!

Legendary bosses like Gonggong, Zhurong, and Poseidon debut with game-breaking exclusive gear!

5. Divine Gear Overhaul
Resistance Gear

Luo River Night Demon Pendant (Freeze Immunity): Drops from Luo River mobs—counters third-continent boss freezes!

Underworld Guardian's Mantle (Paralysis Immunity): Drops from Ghost Market mobs—PvP/PvE essential!

Trinity Force Synthesis

Combine Soulforce (Dragonflame) + Cosmic Force (Benevolence Realm) + Spiritforce (Inferno Realm)

Forged Trinity Force grants massive fixed slicing damage and attack power per piece!

Spirit King Palace Titles

Third-continent hidden titles with godlike stats—miss them, regret forever!

6. Pacing Refinements

Non-stop action: Leveling, hidden lore, title unlocks, and secret maps seamlessly intertwine!

Follow the Phantom Lotus Questline to go from novice to pro in no time!

Endgame freedom: Endless mysteries await your exploration!



Important Notes
[olist]
Report bugs or suggestions via customer support for generous rewards!

Casual players—race for first-kill rights on third-continent white bosses for massive profits!
[/olist]
"Silent Legend" Operations Team
Legendary hardcore fairness awaits—let skill and strategy reign supreme!
Brothers, assemble—this time, conquer with affixes and mastery!
